title: senecio rivularis
intro: Senecio rivularis, commonly known as River Senecio, is a plant species native to South Africa. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various ailments, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Senecio rivularis include its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help in relieving congestion and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
